Dataset Purpose: Measures short-term changes in industrial production volume across key sectors to track economic activity.
Geographic Coverage: Nation-wide, compiled and published by the National Statistical Office (NSO).
Population Coverage: Covers all industrial activities within the country’s Mining, Manufacturing, and Electricity sectors.
Key Variables: Monthly production volume indices for mining, manufacturing, and electricity sectors.
Sample Size / Scope: Monthly, comprehensive coverage of all industrial sectors; no specified sample size due to census-like nature of industrial output reporting.
Important Notes: Data reflects volume changes, not value; published by NSO; sector-specific indices are aggregated into a composite IIP index.
